g.title: Sheet.1323
g.desc: What if you send a letter without an envelope that has any in...
g.text: What if you send a letter without an envelope that has any information - no sender or recipient name, address, or post code?

g.title: Sheet.1325
g.desc: The letter won’t reach anyone. The postal service won’t know ...
g.text: The letter won’t reach anyone. The postal service won’t know where to deliver it.
